sourceLimits: Internal original-project authority, not an external franchise reference.
V2 portrait is current in both HEROES_DB.portrait and production.audiovisual.portrait; restored tracked LFS image is not new generation.
The source rapier tip is outside its frame, so complete blade length/tip remain conservative extrapolations. Tiny facial/gear embroidery details and unseen angles are not certified1:1.
Same portrait can provide equipment or environment vocabulary; scoped reuse does not create an independent source.
Unknown age: family-safe only and no romance; preserve apparent source age. CG12–15 are explicit hypothetical WhatIf transformations.
All scenes are new original compositions coherent with individual canon; no automatic perfect-fidelity certification.
